obligations.required: Convert the theta estimate and binary Goldbach through 1615000000000 into ternary Goldbach through 10^20
proof_steps: For n <= B+3 choose p=3; oddness gives n-3 even and at least 4.
For B+3 < n <= 2*10^12, apply Bertrand at floor((n-4)/2).
For larger n, compare theta(n-4) with theta(n-B). Each error is less than (B-4)/2.
The resulting prime lies in (n-B,n-4], is greater than 2, and leaves an even remainder in [4,B].
obligations.policy: These are internal conditional helpers. They do not prove the outstanding RH estimate or finite certificate.
